faq.name: faq
faq.title: Questions about early access and free generations

items.title: Is ShipFire free to start?
items.description: Yes for getting started: you get a limited number of free generations. Custom domains, higher limits, and extra publish features use paid credits or plans.

items.title: Can I generate a site today?
items.description: Not fully yet. The product is early access / coming soon. Use the tool area to try the brief flow now; limited free generations open as ShipFire ships.

items.title: What does early access include?
items.description: Early access focuses on describing your business and preparing for draft generation. Editing and publish extras roll out in stages—we mark what is live versus coming soon.

items.title: Can I edit the site after AI generates it?
items.description: That is the intended flow: generate a draft, then refine copy and structure yourself. Editing tools ship with the product—we will not claim live controls that are not ready.

items.title: What counts as a generation?
items.description: One generation is one AI draft run from your description. Loading this page, reading examples, or filling the brief does not use a free generation.

items.title: How many free generations do I get?
items.description: The free allowance is limited and shown in your account when generation opens. Exact numbers may change during early access; paid credits unlock more runs when you need them.

items.title: Will I get a custom domain?
items.description: Publishing to a custom domain is planned as a paid / upgrade path. Early access focuses on drafts and clear limits first.

items.title: Do I need to sign in?
items.description: Browsing the page is open. Signing in lets us track free generations and credits when the generator is live. Sign-in requirements for each action are shown next to the tool.

items.title: How is this different from a static template?
items.description: Templates start from the same layout for everyone. ShipFire drafts structure and copy from your description, then lets you edit. Always review and correct the result before publishing.

items.title: Can I export the site?
items.description: Export options are on the roadmap with publishing. Until then, treat drafts as editable starting points inside ShipFire—not a guaranteed downloadable code package.

items.title: What if the AI draft is wrong?
items.description: Expect to rewrite facts, pricing, and legal claims yourself. AI fills structure and starter copy; you remain responsible for accuracy before anything goes live.

items.title: Who is ShipFire for?
items.description: Solo founders, small businesses, and creators who want a first site fast without a full design cycle—and still want room to edit after the draft.
